title: Akiyama Mizuki — Wanted To Say It In Person〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: Wanted To Say It In Person（4★）

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You back, Enanan? Hope school went okay.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I'm back.
Oh, Yuki, you're also here...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Right. My mom should also be done with hers soon, so... Achoo!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Achoo...? Your sneeze is so cute, Enanan.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Shut it. I tried my best to make sure my mic didn't pick it up.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Haha. I know.
Still, did you catch a cold or something?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Dunno. It did rain on my way to school...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, I got rained on too.
It even started thundering while I was walking.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I decided to pop into a convenience store after getting a little scared, but then I got cold. I dove in the bathtub the second I got home.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm guessing you also got pretty soaked, Yuki, since there weren't many places for you to take shelter. Are you dry and warm now?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I haven't taken a bath yet, but I did dry my hair...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, did you two walk home together...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, I just happened to be in the neighborhood today.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Also, question.
If you're faced with surprise showers again like we were today, would you go and buy an umbrella?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hmm... Probably not if I knew that it would let up after waiting a bit. Seems like a waste of money.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'd probably take shelter or run home.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I know what you mean. Buying an umbrella would be my last resort. What about you, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'd also probably head home without buying one.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, what about while you're taking shelter from the rain? Is there anything you normally do then?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <For example, instead of buying an umbrella, you head to a cafe or a fast food joint to wait out the rain! I mean, it's cheaper, no?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Same here. But this one cafe I went in during a rainstorm had this amazing cake. I felt pretty lucky that time.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You came back at just the right time!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <K, would you buy an umbrella if it suddenly started raining? Would you take shelter? Or would you run home?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Wait, is this some sort of personality test...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <If I'm carrying something that shouldn't get wet, then I might buy one. Otherwise, I'd probably end up looking for shelter...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Huh? That sounds really tiring, so I probably wouldn't...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, taking shelter is probably the best option if you're not pressed for time or anything. I mean, there was thunder today.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <No, we did. It felt very close...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, I was working while I had my headphones on, so that may be why I didn't hear anything...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<There were flashes of lightning...
But I guess it just means you were that focused.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<It is like you to not notice, K...
But what if it was a fire instead? What if you didn't realize until it was too late?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<What...?
Yes, that is a bit scary...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Umm... Anyway, since we're all here now, why don't we get to work?>
